text:
[Council File 26-1471]
Motion (Raman – Nazarian) relative to the initiation and acceptance of grant funding for the LA River Greenway Studio City Habitat Restoration, Beautification, and Safety Project; and, signage for the renaming of the LA River Greenway managed by the Department of Recreation and Parks as the "Melanie Winter Studio City LA River Greenway".
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Accepts grant money for habitat restoration, beautification and safety work on the Studio City section of the LA River Greenway, and orders signs renaming it the Melanie Winter Studio City LA River Greenway.

locations.text: LA River Greenway, Studio City, Los Angeles, CA

details.action: grant acceptance and signage for renaming
